# spire

<!-- Generated by TestProjectDocsFresh (PRUFYX_UPDATE_DOCS=1 go test ./internal/communityapp -run TestProjectDocsFresh). Do not edit. -->

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project spire --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project spire`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project spire --spire-entry-argv FILE --spire-distribution official_upstream|custom_build --from 1.10.4 --to 1.11.0 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--spire-entry-argv-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project spire --spire-entry-argv FILE --from 1.10.4 --to 1.11.0 --spire-distribution official_upstream|custom_build [--spire-entry-argv-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
